business_summary: Suntory Beverage & Food Limited engages in the production and distribution of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, and food products in Japan, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas. The company manufactures and distributes mineral water, coffee drinks, tea drinks, carbonated drinks, sports drinks, health supplements, and food for specified health uses. It offers its products under various brands, including Tennensui, BOSSOrangina, Oasis, Lucozade, Ribena, Tea+, -196, Horoyoi, Kaku Highball, Canadian Club and Dry Ready to Drink Whisky, On The Rocks, SUI Gin & Soda, Kodawari Sakaba no Lemon Sour, ALL-FREE, Non-Al Sakaba Highball, Non-Al Sakaba Lemon Sour, Non-Al de Wine no Kyuujitsu, The Premium Malt's, Suntory Nama Beer, Kinmugi, V, and Essence of Chicken; health and wellness products under the Sesamin EX, Varon, Vistra, and Provamed; and wines under the SUNTORY-Tomi Red, SUNTORY-Tomi Koshu, and Château Lagrange brand names. The company also provides spirits under Hibiki, yamazaki, Hakushu, kakubin, Toki, jim Beam, Maker's Mark, Basil Hayden, Laphroaig, Bowmore, Roku, Haku, and Tres Generaciones brand names. In addition, it operates restaurants, events, and franchise stores; produces and sells tonkatsu; manufactures and sells ice cream; and engages in specialty trading. The company was founded in 1921 and is based in Minato, Japan. Suntory Beverage & Food Limited operates as a subsidiary of Suntory Holdings Limited.
business_summary_ko: Suntory Beverage & Food Limited는 일본, 아시아 태평양, 유럽 및 미주 지역에서 알코올 및 무알코올 음료와 식품의 생산 및 유통에 종사하고 있습니다. 회사는 생수, 커피 음료, 차 음료, 탄산 음료, 스포츠 음료, 건강 보조 식품 및 특정 건강 용도의 식품을 제조 및 유통합니다. Tennensui, BOSSOrangina, Oasis, Lucozade, Ribena, Tea+, -196, Horoyoi, Kaku Highball, Canadian Club 및 Dry Ready to Drink Whisky, On The Rocks, SUI Gin & Soda, Kodawari Sakaba no Lemon Sour, ALL-FREE, Non-Al Sakaba Highball, Non-Al Sakaba Lemon Sour, Non-Al de Wine no 등 다양한 브랜드로 제품을 제공합니다. 규지츠, 더 프리미엄 몰츠, 산토리 나마 맥주, 킨무기, V, 에센스 오브 치킨; Sesamin EX, Varon, Vistra 및 Provamed의 건강 및 웰니스 제품; SUNTORY-Tomi Red, SUNTORY-Tomi Koshu 및 Château Lagrange 브랜드 이름의 와인. 이 회사는 또한 Hibiki, yamazaki, Hakushu, kakubin, Toki, jim Beam, Maker's Mark, Basil Hayden, Laphroaig, Bowmore, Roku, Haku 및 Tres Generaciones 브랜드 이름으로 증류주를 제공합니다. 그 밖에도 레스토랑, 이벤트, 프랜차이즈 매장 등을 운영하고 있습니다.
